The systemd user service is installed to `${pkgdir}/usr/lib/systemd/user/`, indicating it is intended for user-level services, not system-wide daemons, which aligns with typical sandboxed application behavior. There are no signs of data exfiltration, backdoors, or unauthorized network activity in the packaging logic. The package adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and presents no evidence of supply-chain compromise.

While the package uses prebuilt binaries (which inherently limits transparency), the sources are correctly pinned and checksummed, and no runtime modifications or network calls are embedded in this file.
